fact: Egypt's AI council adopted a report saying more than 40 AI applications are in use across the government and banking sectors.
The same report counts more than 40 AI applications across government and banking.
Minister Raafat Hindi said efforts are under way to develop the capabilities of EG-CERT, under the National Telecom Regulatory Authority, by using AI techniques against cyber threats.
Egypt's Ministry of Communications and Information Technology announced the pilot launch of Karnak Chat, a chatbot built on its Karnak model, open to users by web registration or a Google Play app.
The IDSC policy perspective says different projects are proceeding on the use of AI in different governmental entities, in health, water management, agriculture and Arabic NLP.
MCIT adviser Huda Baraka says more than 40 AI applications are already in use in various government bodies.
MCIT adviser Huda Baraka says more than 40 AI applications are in use across different government bodies, and a number of ministries and agencies have begun using small language models.

The Central Agency for Organization and Administration launched the AI chatbot KMT, which answers more than 50,000 civil-service legal and administrative questions for civil servants and the public via its website, WhatsApp and Facebook, according to the USAID Economic Governance Activity press release.

Tendersinfo lists a tender dated 24 April 2026, closing 6 May 2026, which it says Egypt's Ministry of Communications and Information Technology initiated for technical support and artificial intelligence for a paperless ministry (messaging) system.

Consumer Protection Agency head Ibrahim El-Segini said at Egypt Forum 2026 that the agency is using AI to analyse consumer complaints, inspection campaign data, prices, advertisements and online stores to detect violation patterns and high-risk sectors.

The Cabinet Media Center launched the Chat Egypt platform, which uses AI to analyse text, images and video to detect and verify rumours, with more than 21,000 data entries added and ministries, agencies and governorates uploading their own verified data.
